Benjamin_1: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 35:18)
Samuel_1: the leader of the tribe of Simeon (Numbers 34:20) to apportion the Land (Numbers 34:17)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Saul_1: son of Kish (1 Samuel 9:2), King of Israel (1 Samuel 11:15)
Abishai_1: son of Zeruiah and Joab's brother (1 Samuel 26:6), chief of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:18)
Zeruiah_1: mother of Abishai, Joab (1 Samuel 26:6), and Asahel (2 Samuel 2:18), sister of King David (1 Chronicles 2:16)
Joab_1: son of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 2:13), commander of David's army (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Asahel_1: brother of Joab and Abishai (2 Samuel 2:18), sixth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:24)
Benaiah_1: over the Cherethites and the Pelethites (2 Samuel 8:18), the fifth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:20)
Jehoiada_1: father of Benaiah (2 Samuel 8:18), a priest (1 Chronicles 27:5)
Uriah_1: the Hittite (2 Samuel 11:3), thirty-seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:39)
Ittai_1: the Gittite (2 Samuel 15:19), seventeenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:29)
Sibbecai_1: the Hushathite (2 Samuel 21:18) of the Zerahites
Elhanan_1: son of Jaare-oregim (2 Samuel 21:19), seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:24)
Josheb-basshebeth_1: first of "the thirty" of David's men, a Tahchemonite (2 Samuel 23:8)/Hachmonite (1 Chronicles 11:11)
Eleazar_3: second of "the thirty" of David's men, son of Dodo (2 Samuel 23:9)
Dodo_2: an Ahohite (1 Chronicles 11:12) father of Eleazar, one of David's mighty men (2 Samuel 23:9)
Shammah_4: the Harodite, eighth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:25)
Helez_1: the Paltite (Pelonite in 1 Chronicles 11:27), tenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:26)
Ira_2: son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, eleventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:26)
Ikkesh_1: father of Ira, one of David's mighty men (2 Samuel 23:26)
Abiezer_1: the Anathothite (2 Samuel 23:27), twelfth of "the thirty" of David's men
Zalmon_1: the Ahohite (2 Samuel 23:28), fourteenth of "the thirty" of David's men
Maharai_1: the Netophathite (2 Samuel 23:28), fifteenth of "the thirty" of David's men
Heleb_1: son of Baanah (2 Samuel 23:29), sixteenth of "the thirty" of David's men
Baanah_2: father of Heleb, one of David's mighty men (2 Samuel 23:29)
Ribai_1: of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin (2 Samuel 23:29)
Benaiah_2: the Pirathonite, eighteenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:30)
Hiddai_1: of the brooks of Gaash, nineteenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:30)
Abi-albon_1: the Arbathite, twentieth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:31)
Azmaveth_1: the Barhumite (Baharumite 1 Chronicles 11:33), twenty-first of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:31)
Eliahba_1: the Shaalbonite, twenty-second of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:32)
Jashen_1: son of Eliahba, twenty-third of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:32)
Jonathan_5: son of Eliahba, twenty-fourth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:32)
Shammah_5: the Hararite (2 Samuel 23:33), twenty-fifth of "the thirty" of David's men
Ahiam_1: son of Sharar (2 Samuel 23:33), twenty-sixth of "the thirty" of David's men
Eliphelet_2: son of Ahasbai, twenty-seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:34)
Ahasbai_1: father of Eliphelet, son of the Maacathite (2 Samuel 23:34)
Eliam_2: son of Ahithophel, twenty-eighth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:34)
Hezro_1: the Carmelite, twenty-ninth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:35)
Paarai_1: the Arbite, thirtieth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:35)
Igal_2: son of Nathan, thirty-first of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:36)
Bani_1: the Gadite, thirty-second of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:36)
Zelek_1: the Ammonite, thirty-third of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:37)
Naharai_1: the Beerothite, thirty-fourth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:37)
Ira_3: the Ithrite, thirty-fifth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:38)
Gareb_1: the Ithrite, thirty-sixth of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:38)
Ezbai_1: father of Naarai (1 Chronicles 11:37) [Paarai in 2 Samuel 23:35]
Hanan_3: son of Maacah and Joshaphat the Mithnite (1 Chronicles 11:43)
Shama_1: son of Hotham the Aroerite (1 Chronicles 11:44)
Jeiel_3: son of Hotham the Aroerite (1 Chronicles 11:44)
Joha_2: the Tizite, brother of Jediael (1 Chronicles 11:45)
Elnaam_1: father of Jeribai and Joshaviah (1 Chronicles 11:46)
